audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Printed stochastic-quantization signs give a false finite-dimensional Gibbs identity; High-order local flow coefficients need not satisfy the claimed decaying graded estimate; Wick recursion contraction range omits last variable
limitations: Printed stochastic-quantization signs give a false finite-dimensional Gibbs identity — Counterevidence: Reversing drift repairs the diagnostic example; sourcep48itself uses plusG drift. A coherent alternate convention is plausible, but needs consistent changes throughout. Sourcep9fixes operator composition.

High-order local flow coefficients need not satisfy the claimed decaying graded estimate — Counterevidence: The special cubic dataK1=0,K3=lambda psiÂ³are not refuted; bare finite-order existence can hold without the claimed uniform norm. Changing contraction sign changes only signs, not even-order nonzero limits.
Wick recursion contraction range omits last variable — Counterevidence: A local index correction restores the degree-two assertion.
Smooth nondecreasing saturation has incompatible endpoint values — Counterevidence: A nearby smooth cutoff is readily constructed by starting transition atA-1 or raising the plateau.

Claimed lower two-point comparison lacks a test-function mass condition — Counterevidence: Nonnegative unit-mass mollifiers with specified nonzero component pairing plausibly give intended lower bound.

Counterevidence and scope: Sourcep9 fixes rightmost-first derivative composition; p48 uses the opposite drift sign, indicating a plausible intended convention. Coordinated sign corrections can restore the diagnostic, but do not validate the printed formulas. Core Gibbs identification is used explicitly in3.30, Remark4.26 and Lemma4.29. No continuum theorem counterexample claimed. Retained original exact matrix outputs support, but are not attributed to a new run.

Counterevidence and scope: Theorem4.13 permits linear boundary data and epsilon=0. Its literal finite-time existence assertion is not disproved; the false uniform graded-norm induction and4.23/4.24 are the target. Special cubic data of Corollary4.15 remain unrefuted; sourcep37 nevertheless invokes this induction, and Proposition4.20 requires the norm bound. Retain actual-model B check separately from the older real-J diagnostic; no new 24-order computation claimed.
Counterevidence and scope: Index repair is distinct from the calculus sign convention inP1; no additional final theorem refutation.
Counterevidence and scope: The exact definition is impossible, while a replacement cutoff exists; the covariance estimates for that replacement are not silently certified.

Counterevidence and scope: This refutes the free lower comparison used inRemark1.4 for the stated test class, not Theorem1.3 upper difference bound. Positivity/unit-mass and a nonzero component pairing are additional intended restrictions, not present hypotheses.
